question:
Select the correct mirror image of the given combination when the mirror is placed at 'PQ' as shown below.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ea771875ec173ac2e3b1b4966a55ba38e59678ab4bd053e9b1435779b56ad2fb.png]
solution:
The correct mirror image of the given figure when the mirror is held on the right side.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f012ac5da4a7e4c3cfa1e4dd73edbb63d02240a6c91d4418dc0da179f21c6dfc.png] 

__Detailed Explanation:__

__
 
• The correct mirror image of the given figure is " [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/576b7b781dde7126be5c98f06c2b831d71220b4fbeee565744f15d0c7573f6d7.png] " the third alphabet of the given image is 'A' and the alphabet given in option 3 and 4 is 'N' so both Option 3 and 4 is eliminated. 
 
• The correct mirror image of the given figure is " [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/576b7b781dde7126be5c98f06c2b831d71220b4fbeee565744f15d0c7573f6d7.png] " the last letter of the given image is 'L' and the alphabet given in option 1 is 'I' so Option 1 is eliminated.

 

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

1) In the mirror image left side and right side changed vice-versa where the top and bottom remain the same.

2) In a real given mirror image the farthest number or alphabet appears closest in the mirror image.
